authority: Original archive records, revisions, manifests and source ACLs are unchanged
metadata: generations/index_<id>.json, canonical digest; contains sidecar hashes, space identity and watermark
tfidf_vectors: float64 CSR npz, no full-corpus dense list conversion during build
failure: Missing, corrupt, wrong-shape or wrong-space artifacts cannot be installed or used for rollback
compatibility: CompactMemoryIndex reads legacy and compact; legacy reader needs rollback to a legacy generation before downgrade
evaluation: Candidate ranking and presented evidence are measured independently of answer quality; no answer score without supplied citations
production: No forced migration, deletion, live model calls or service restart
